nodes.label: Fallback Faq 1 Title
nodes.value: Do I need to book an appointment?

nodes.label: Fallback Faq 1 Text
nodes.value: Walk-ins are welcome when a chair is free, but booking through our appointment page guarantees your slot with your preferred stylist.

nodes.label: Fallback Faq 2 Text
nodes.value: Five to ten minutes before your appointment is perfect — it gives us time for a quick consultation before we start.

nodes.label: Fallback Faq 3 Text
nodes.value: Of course. Use the link in your confirmation email, or give us a call at least 24 hours ahead so we can offer the slot to someone else.

nodes.label: Fallback Faq 4 Title
nodes.value: Do you sell the products you use?

nodes.label: Fallback Faq 4 Text
nodes.value: Yes — everything we use in the salon is available in our shop, with delivery straight to your door.

values.title: Do I need to book an appointment?
values.text: Walk-ins are welcome when a chair is free, but booking through our appointment page guarantees your slot with your preferred stylist.

values.title: How early should I arrive?
values.text: Five to ten minutes before your appointment is perfect — it gives us time for a quick consultation before we start.

values.title: Can I reschedule or cancel?
values.text: Of course. Use the link in your confirmation email, or give us a call at least 24 hours ahead so we can offer the slot to someone else.

values.title: Do you sell the products you use?
values.text: Yes — everything we use in the salon is available in our shop, with delivery straight to your door.
